modmenu.summaryTranslation.playtime_toge: Server-wide playtime records with a personal leaderboard.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.playtime_: The host or server records and saves everyone's online duration. Customize the sidebar, player selection and blocking rules. No cheats required.
playtime_together.hud.title: 在线时长
playtime_together.config.title: Online Duration Counter
playtime_together.config.key_help: Y opens configuration by default. Click above to bind a keyboard or mouse button.
playtime_together.config.key_listening: Waiting for input; Esc cancels. Delete / Backspace clears the binding.
playtime_together.config.key_conflict: Conflicts with %s. Click the button above to rebind.
playtime_together.config.no_world: Join a world with the mod installed to select players and configure this world's rules.
playtime_together.rules.title: Player blocking rules
playtime_together.rules.keywords_help: Separate keywords with commas or semicolons. Matching ignores case.
playtime_together.rules.regex_help: Any matching rule is enough. Empty rules do not match anything.
playtime_together.rules.selection_help: Select matching keeps only matches. Deselect matching removes matches from your current selection.
playtime_together.rules.auto_notice: Automatic blocking still hides selected matches. Turn it off to select by rule. Recording continues on the server.
playtime_together.rules.local_notice: Rules affect this client's display and selection only. Recording continues. Preferences are saved per world.
playtime_together.colors.title: Title
playtime_together.colors.subtitle: Subtitle
playtime_together.colors.invalid: Use #RRGGBB. Invalid edits keep the last valid color.
playtime_together.position.title: Edit sidebar position
playtime_together.position.help: Drag content to move; drag edges/corners to resize; arrows nudge (Shift speeds up)
